source.prompt: A chestnut-backed chickadee (Poecile rufescens), a tiny songbird about 11 cm long, one adult perched with its wings folded tight against the body, side-on pose. A round fluffy body, a big round head, a tiny short black bill, a medium-long narrow tail. A sooty dark brown cap and a black bib, bright white cheeks, a rich chestnut back and flanks, grey wings and tail, a white belly. Thin dark legs, three toes forward and one back. No base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: Scaled to 0.115 m bill to tail. The preview's tail (0.65 units of 1.9, too long) cut off behind the wingtips and replaced by a narrower square tail of 5 cm, 14 degrees below level; round head and tiny bill kept; generated legs replaced by dark procedural legs; small black eye; flight wing cards (rounded, grey with pale edges on lod0). Colours: sooty dark brown cap to just below the eye and down the nape, a large black bib, bright white cheeks running back to the neck sides, rich chestnut back, rump and flanks, grey wings with pale edges and a pale lower edge to the folded wing, grey tail, white belly centre, dark legs and bill. Triangles: lod0 999 = 766 body + 233 legs, tail, cards and eyes; lod1 399 = 310 + 89; lod2 119 = 92 + 27. GLB 178,772 bytes. lod_m is a suggestion for an 11 cm bird.

rig: bird rig template of the Steller's jay (tools/build_stellersjay.py; drawn with client/src/animalModels.js RIG.stjay's constants): PART BODY 0, LEG_A 1 / LEG_B 2 procedural legs (pivot at the knee), TAIL 3 procedural tail (pivot at the rump), HEAD 6 (head and neck, pivot at the base of the neck), WING_L/R 4/5 and HAND_L/R 9/10 flight cards that collapse into the shoulder on pose; extras.rig {kind 'bird', wing (shoulder), tail (rump), head (neck base), length_m}; no skin
accuracy_notes: Built 2026-11-05. Reads at once as a chestnut-backed chickadee: brown cap, black bib, white cheeks, chestnut back and flanks, white belly. Still open: the edges of the bib and cheeks are saw-toothed (per-face colour on a 770-face body); the tail reads thin side-on (a flat plate); no pale wing-panel detail beyond the edges.
